name: android_list_packages
description: Lists packages installed on the device with optional third-party filter and search query.

deviceSerial.description: Device serial or IP:port from android_list_devices. Required when several devices are connected; may be omitted when only one is.

thirdPartyOnly.description: If true, only lists non-system third-party apps (default true).

query.description: Optional search keyword to filter package names.
